_meta.epss_kev_note: CVSS values are from NVD. EPSS scores and `exploited_in_wild` flags here are ILLUSTRATIVE sample values, not authoritative. KEV flags reflect a point-in-time reading of the CISA KEV catalog and may be out of date.

pyyaml.summary: A vulnerability in PyYAML allows arbitrary code execution when untrusted YAML is processed with FullLoader / yaml.full_load, via crafted python/object/new tags. Incomplete fix for CVE-2020-1747.

jinja2.summary: Jinja2 sandbox escape via str.format_map, allowing an attacker who controls a template to break out of the sandbox.

requests.summary: requests sends the Authorization header to a different host after a cross-origin redirect, leaking credentials to a third party.

flask.summary: Flask is vulnerable to denial of service via crafted encoding when the JSON body has no Content-Type header, causing unexpected memory use.

urllib3.summary: urllib3 ReDoS: a very long authority component in a supplied URL leads to catastrophic backtracking and denial of service.
